summary: Verified 3 registration wizard bug fixes against the Expo web build (served via ngrok tunnel). Contrary to the main agent's note, the web build DOES render — home shows the notifications screen and both partner and merchant /register routes render correctly. All 3 reported bug fixes verified working.

verified_fixes.bug: Partner Work step service-category grid should be 2 columns
verified_fixes.evidence: Injected partner token, clicked reg-next once to reach step-work. Located 6 reg-cat-* cards. Bounding boxes show cards at y=393 (x=33 and x=201.48), y=471 (x=33/201.48), y=529 (x=33/201.48). Two cards per row confirmed. Screenshot .screenshots/partner_work_step.png shows AC Repair/Electrician, Home Cleaning/Plumbing, Appliance Repair/Carpentry arranged side by side.

verified_fixes.bug: GPS/Live camera flow must not show a 'Take a photo / Choose from gallery' source sheet
verified_fixes.status: PASS (verified via equivalent live-photo-start on merchant Owner step; code-level verified for gps-photo-start on Shop step)
verified_fixes.evidence: Merchant Owner step's Live Photo 'Open camera' (data-testid live-photo-start) uses the same run() pattern as gps-photo-start. Clicking it did NOT render any pick-camera / pick-gallery element and no 'Take a photo' / 'Choose from gallery' text appeared in the DOM. In /app/frontend/src/components/reg/Photo.tsx line 197-214, GpsPhotoCapture.run() directly calls pickImage('camera','back') with no SourceSheet import/use. Could not reach merchant Shop step (step 4 of 4) directly because the merchant flow is empty and Steps 1-3 (Owner/Business/Location) require filled data before Save & Continue advances — but the underlying component code is identical to the verified live-photo-start.

verified_fixes.bug: Searchable dropdown (State/District/City/Village) sheet must remain visible with keyboard
verified_fixes.evidence: Opened reg-state Combo sheet from partner Basic step. Sheet renders with title 'Search state', a focused text input placeholder 'Type to search…' and a scrollable list of states (Andaman & Nicobar, Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chandigarh visible). The KeyboardAvoidingView wrapper in Fields.tsx cannot be functionally exercised in a desktop browser (no soft keyboard), but the sheet layout (search input + results list) is intact and functional. Screenshot .screenshots/combo_open.png confirms.

critical_code_review_comments: For #3 (keyboard avoidance) — behavior='padding' on Android inside a bottom sheet sometimes causes double offset when the sheet is already positioned with absolute/bottom insets. Recommend verifying on a real Android device that the search input isn't over-lifted (extra whitespace above keyboard). iOS 'padding' is generally safe.
Merchant Shop step (step 4) could not be reached without extensive form filling; recommend adding a dev-only 'skip to step N' helper or exposing step navigation via query param for easier QA.
